title: 第十六章 我的尸体第十七章 开怪
content_zh:
看起来他所猜测的没错，通过这十字路口的方法就在这个商店之中。
只是这个要求.....
好吧，代价确实都不是什么致命的东西，如果只买一样的话，人没了一段肠一颗肾也照样能活得下去，哪怕最危险的肝，在缺失了三分之一的情况下，也能在勉强维持人体的生命活动。
但说实话，周游一丁点都不想把自己的内脏给予他人——而且看这店铺的模样，估摸也没什么手术室之类的设施，谁知道这老太婆会用什么方式取出这些东西？
更别提从之前的言语中来看，这家伙坑掉自己的概率远远高出和自己正常做买卖的概率。
所以嘛……
看着周游面色陷入迟疑，店主露出了个十分和善的笑容。
“怎么，您这是没找到什么中意的嘛？”
语气倒是十分友好，可某人却不由得感觉到一阵恶寒。
对方那感觉就像是不是在说‘你挑好了没有’，而是在说‘你想成为什么商品’一样。
周游一丁点都不想变成那个福尔马林中的头颅，所以他赶忙将那个疑似人皮的商品目录轻轻推回，然后笑着说道。
“中意的我倒是看到了几样，但是我现在....有点囊中羞涩，只能选一个。”
话罢，周游在那目录上轻轻点了点。
那店主终于露出了个满意的笑容。
“客人您真是好眼光，那么请问你是打算用什么付款呢？本店童叟无欺，这个东西只要您的两条腿，一只眼睛，或者......”
不过在它说完之前，系统已经代周游做出了回答。
他张开手，露出掌心间的一把东西。
原本只是一个数字的魂晶到了现实里，已经变成了一种晦暗的方块。
老板的笑容忽然停了下，接着陡然变得越发灿烂了起来。
“这是....高品质的炼阴块？啧啧啧，这年代可不多见了，毕竟自从那帮牛鼻子死光后就很少有人有这种炼阴为实的手段了.....这件商品倒也能接受这种付款，所以说嘛.......”

那老板招了招手，货架上的一个坛子便漂浮到了他的面前，只见那坛口自行打开，伴随着一阵熟悉的恶臭味道，一只苍白的手颤颤巍巍地从其中伸出，将货物放到了柜台上。
正是那个染血的小刀。
从外观来看，这只是一把小巧玲珑的匕首，通体漆黑，样式十分普通，但在周游握住刀柄的时候，却忽然产生了一种莫名的冲动。
——将这个匕首刺进自己的**，将自己的内脏一点点的刨出，让鲜血浸透刀锋的每一个角落.....
等到，我在想什么？
周游猛地抬起头，却只看到了老板那带着诡异笑容的脸庞。
“怎么，您觉得合心嘛？”
周游盯了几秒那满是恶意的眼睛，忽然同样展颜一笑。
“当然满意，如果有可能我还想给老板您一个五星好评，一星给东西，四星给服务——不过话说回来。”他将匕首收回怀里，然后像是不经意的提起了一句。“老板你这店晚上还开吗？”
“......为什么这么问？”
看着老板那警惕的神情，周游笑的倒是十分平常。
“其实也没啥意思，主要是我还看上了几样其他的东西，可惜就像刚才说的，现在我手头不太宽裕，估计得等晚上才能凑齐钱款，所以想问问你这里晚上是否营业？”
但听到这话，一直游刃有余的店主却忽然迟疑了一下。
“营业......倒是营业，但是我也得告诉客人你一声，你晚上要过来的时候得小心点，这段时间夜里不太平，我这店虽然藏得比较隐蔽，也能够在一定程度上屏蔽他们的感知，但归根结底还是不想招惹那些存在，所以你想购物可以，但别给我惹麻烦，懂吗？”
那话语中满是威胁之意。
而系统的提示也在下一秒响起。
content_en:
It seemed that what he guessed was right, the way through this intersection was in this store.
Just this requirement...
Well, the price is indeed not a fatal thing. If you only buy one thing, a person can still live without a section of intestines and a kidney. Even the most dangerous liver can barely maintain the life activities of the human body when a third of it is missing.
But to be honest, Zhou You doesn't want to give his internal organs to others at all - and judging from the appearance of this shop, there is probably no operating room or other facilities. Who knows how this old woman will take out these things?
Not to mention that judging from his previous words, the probability of this guy cheating on him is much higher than the probability of doing business with him normally.
So...
Seeing the hesitation on Zhou You's face, the shop owner showed a very kind smile.
"Why, you haven't found anything you like?"
The tone was very friendly, but someone couldn't help but feel a chill.
It feels like the other party is not saying, ‘Have you made your choice?’ but rather, ‘What kind of product do you want to be?’.
Zhou You didn't want to become that head in formalin at all, so he quickly pushed back the product catalog that looked like human skin, and then said with a smile.
"I saw a few that I liked, but now...I'm a little short of money, so I can only choose one."
After saying that, Zhou You clicked lightly on the directory.
The shop owner finally showed a satisfied smile.
"Guest, you are really discerning, so what do you plan to use to pay? We are an honest shop. This thing only requires your two legs, one eye, or..."
But before it finished speaking, the system had already answered on behalf of Zhou You.
He opened his hand, revealing something in his palm.
The Soul Crystal, which was originally just a number, has turned into a dark square in reality.
The boss's smile suddenly stopped, and then suddenly became brighter.
"This is...a high-quality Yin Refining Block? Tsk, tsk, tsk, it's rare in this era. After all, since those bull noses died, very few people have this kind of method of refining Yin... This product can accept this kind of payment, so..."
The boss waved, and a jar on the shelf floated in front of him. The mouth of the jar opened on its own, and along with a familiar stench, a pale hand stretched out tremblingly from it and placed the goods on the counter.
It was the bloody knife.
From the outside, it was just a small and exquisite dagger, completely black and very ordinary in style. But when Zhou You held the handle of the knife, he suddenly felt an inexplicable urge.
——Pierce this dagger into your own chest, dig out your internal organs bit by bit, and let the blood soak into every corner of the blade...
Wait, what was I thinking?
Zhou You suddenly raised his head, but only saw the boss's face with a strange smile.
"What, do you think it suits you?"
Zhou You stared at those malicious eyes for a few seconds, then suddenly smiled as well.
"Of course I'm satisfied. If possible, I would like to give you a five-star review, boss. One star for the items and four stars for the service - but then again." He put the dagger back into his arms and mentioned it casually. "Boss, is your store still open at night?"
"...Why do you ask?"
Looking at the boss's vigilant expression, Zhou You smiled quite normally.
"Actually, it's not that interesting. The main thing is that I also have my eye on a few other things. Unfortunately, as I said just now, I don't have much money now. I probably have to wait until the evening to get the money together, so I wanted to ask you if this place is open at night?"
But after hearing this, the shop owner who had always been comfortable suddenly hesitated.For a moment.
"It's open... it's open, but I also have to tell you, you have to be careful when you come over at night. It's not peaceful at night during this period. Although my store is relatively hidden and can block their perception to a certain extent, in the final analysis, I still don't want to provoke those beings, so you can go shopping if you want, but don't get me into trouble, understand?"
Those words were full of threats.
The system prompt also sounded the next second.
